title: Consumer fintech wallet (single marketing homepage) web-product generation policy

classification.marketModel: direct-to-consumer mobile wallet (individuals sending, receiving and saving money); waitlist pre-launch
sourceEvidence: index.html:6 page title names the product a 'Global Neobank'
src/components/Hero.jsx:58 the hero body speaks to one person (second person) about a personal wallet
src/components/Faq.jsx:19 and :26 describe a phone app (the wallet app; keys on the user's iPhone/Android, biometrics)
src/components/Payroll.jsx:66-69 payroll is framed from the earner's side (getting paid), not as an employer/team tool
src/components/Waitlist.jsx: the only conversion is an individual email waitlist
absent from src/ and CLONE_SPEC.md: pricing tiers or plans, seats/teams, dashboards for an organisation, integrations, a B2B sign-up or demo request

notBoundTo.n0-saas-design-constraints-common: Explicitly NOT applied. That policy assumes a B2B SaaS product (pricing tiers, dashboards, feature matrices, integrations, team/seat language). The clone is a consumer mobile-wallet marketing homepage; none of those constructs exist in the source and a generator must not introduce them. Binding to it would need a recorded architecture decision, which has not been made.

generationRules: Pages are drawn only from template.home and its 12 section contracts; no pricing-table, plan-comparison, feature-matrix, integrations, dashboard or team/seat sections.

Copy addresses an individual consumer in the second person; financial claims (speed, fees, yields) are the operator's own and must be substantiated by them; source claims are rejected (GENERATION_MODE_CLAIM).
Trust content (partners, security) uses generation-safe roles only: placeholder.company-logo, fictional.person; real partner trademarks and real people are blocked-for-generation.
mode=generation rejects every source identity/content category (GENERATION_MODE_* rules); mode=clone is a private fidelity build only.
The waitlist endpoint is project-supplied in both modes; the source company's live endpoint is never allowed.

approval.note: Classification defined by an agent from evidence in the clone (agent attestation, not a human sign-off). A human architecture owner must ratify it before it is treated as a shared common policy. Asset licensing and publishing approvals remain open (registry.manifest.json productionApproved: false).
